<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha elections:</strong> The Election Commission of India has scheduled polls for 12 Rajya Sabha seats across Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal for October 16.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court has demanded a response from the ECI regarding &quot;logical discrepancy&quot; notices issued during the Delhi voter verification process and is reviewing the status of millions of pending voter exclusion appeals in West Bengal.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxQS2hoM3hyX1I0UzdhbzBsekFuQ28yX2NfRmlYdzYwTzE2Y1VrckNFems0TDAydWRQdlVZXzJCanI2ME96VHhFdWh2Tm10TnVQclpaWGNBaEtrNFY2SEx5YmREdC1XOTRPd1Zzc3lhMXBiYnU2WmpnNDU4aE9MV05JaTJ6X2dXQXdmcWoySzB4OVRrbDBxRk4yelp5TEQtMDZOSVZvZlhualNPcXRuek5sckFYQXl3WEY2NGs0c0JCbmR6YUZUSV8zN0R0SQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative developments:</strong> Parliament has passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, even as a constitutional amendment bill seeking to provide women&#x27;s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies failed to pass in the Lower House.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQU3ZPV0tBQ0k0Q2ZRTFZWZ1JVTjIyOWY4U2VVcEtUMzNURDBlSUdheU1TamkwWWZSQTczRXR2ZUttTUZkdnBJS2JhdFRQTmlIamtZZEpEQ2ROOVJISm9OSXhEYk84TmUyZUJOTHgzci1PaVFSeTlHMWpzQV9rOWEwWHNualRibzRieVJzSXNRY1ZDdVVsSGhGdEVFRjZXeEhoSnFkS2RnbUNpRFFfaFFiWEQwQUVSbGZiZW91ZFpnTjZOLVF0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
